d:
A nice Item song from Sajid Khan's film, has nice catchy tune composed Himesh Reshammiya while lyrics are penned by Shabbir Ahmed.
Song: Piya Ke Bazaar Mein
Singers - Himesh Reshammiya, Shalmali Kholgade & Palak Muchhal
Composer - Himesh Reshammiya
Lyricist - Shabbir Ahmed
Humshakals - the year's biggest comedy, directed by Sajid Khan. Its whackier, its crazier and we are promising 9 times the fun ! Starring Saif Ali Khan, Ritiesh Deshmukh, Ram Kapoor with a bevvy of beauties - Bipasha Basu, Tamannah Bhatia and Esha Gupta.
Piya Ke Bazaar Mein Lyrics
By God teri seva karenge
